_meta.description: Candidate lunar south-pole outpost sites. Replace all 'value' fields marked verified:false with real readings from LRO QuickMap before using in the sim.
_meta.how_to_fill: Open quickmap.lroc.asu.edu, switch on the LOLA elevation layer, the WAC polar illumination layer, and the LEND polar hydrogen layer. Read the value at each site's coordinates and record the date.
